# Returns Desk onboarding

First-run playbook for any Returns Desk instance. Checklist-first. No silent defaults. Never bake user-specific emails or inbox names — discover connected accounts at runtime.

## When to run
- First conversation / no `onboarding complete` in memory
- User wants to connect mail, change send mode, or change preferred dropoffs

## Done checklist
- [ ] At least one order/shipping/return mailbox connected OR user deferred with a clear next step
- [ ] Send mode chosen via widget (no default): Just me | Just someone else | Me + someone else | Ask every time
- [ ] Partner email collected only when send mode needs it
- [ ] Preferred dropoffs via multiselect (no silent default): Amazon dropoff (Whole Foods / Kohl's / Hub) | Happy Returns | UPS Pickup | Other
- [ ] Amazon login deferred until first Amazon return needs it
- [ ] CS From hard rule reminded: From = purchase mailbox; ask if unclear
- [ ] Memory: `onboarding complete` then proceed to eligible inventory — never invent a catalog

## Mail connect
1. Discover mail with GetMcpServerStatus / add-connector patterns. Never treat host-fleet connector labels as this shopper’s mail without their explicit pick.
2. Gmail: OAuth multi-account with user-chosen labels (e.g. “Gmail — shopping”). Follow add-connector; never paste OAuth links.
3. AOL/IMAP: app-password playbook — generate app password in AOL Account Security; collect via secret-request / setup fields only (never chat paste; never store in skill or ordinary memory). Local MCP command connector; confirm with read-only folder list. Prefer Gmail-first if one inbox is enough.
4. User may defer a mailbox; record what’s missing.

## Persist
- `send mode: …`
- `send mode partner email: …` only when collected
- `preferred dropoff networks: …`

## Anti-patterns
Baking emails; silent-defaulting send mode/dropoffs; requiring Amazon login during onboarding; inventing inventory; saying “plugin/MCP/plugin id” to the user.

# Eligible returns inventory

Scan connected order/shipping/return mail for items still eligible to return. Never invent catalog, prices, order ids, or deadlines. Discover mailboxes at runtime.

Separate from Packages (inbound tracking) and Support (CS triage).

## When to run
After `onboarding complete`, or user asks what’s returnable / show inventory / scan for returns.

## Done checklist
- [ ] Onboarding complete (else run Returns Desk onboarding)
- [ ] Connected mail discovered at runtime (Gmail + AOL/local); no baked addresses
- [ ] All confirmed order/shipping/return mailboxes scanned (~90–180 days default)
- [ ] Parse when possible: merchant, title, order id, deadline, price (else `price unknown`), status
- [ ] Deduplicate across mailboxes/threads
- [ ] Present clear list; when returning, multiselect with values = stable_ids
- [ ] Optional snapshot under `/workspace/returns-desk/inventory/eligible-YYYY-MM-DD.json`
- [ ] Hand off selected items — no auto-submit

## Signal patterns
Return by / prep return / RMA / return label / QR / Happy Returns / Amazon dropoff / retailer return confirmation.

Out of scope: pure shipped/delivered tracking; non-return CS threads; silent auto-returns.

## Anti-patterns
Inventing rows; baking emails; treating inbound tracking as returns; returning without multiselect.

# Amazon return questionnaire

Amazon return gate after selected inventory rows (stable_ids). Widgets, then confirm before every submit. Never invent order ids, ASINs, barcodes, deadlines, or reason codes.

## Done checklist
- [ ] Input = selected inventory rows or run Eligible returns inventory / ask
- [ ] Widgets: item(s), Refund vs Replacement, return method Dropoff | Pickup | Label
- [ ] Preferred dropoffs from memory are suggestions only — still ask
- [ ] Reason/condition only when Amazon’s live flow requires it
- [ ] Confirm-before-submit summary + explicit yes before every Amazon commit
- [ ] Auth/2FA/bot-detection: hand user the screen (box-help / credentials); never paste passwords
- [ ] After prep: hand off to Returns Desk PDF pack / amazon-whole-foods-return-pdf for QR; deliver issued labels per send mode
- [ ] Fail closed if QR/label missing — never invent

## Anti-patterns
Auto-submit; skipping confirm; silent method from preferences; inventing reasons/QR; baking accounts.

# Returns Desk PDF pack

Build printable pack from real return assets, then deliver by send mode. Covers Amazon QR dropoff (navy card) and Happy Returns–style packs.

## Standing quality rules
- Product photo only — never retailer PDP chrome
- QR-only sharp re-encode (~900px+; decode+re-encode preferred); never upscale tiny crops; never Download UI in crop
- Fail closed if QR missing
- Attach/show full PDF BEFORE any send-mode widget
- Preview all pages OR say “N-page pack; showing sample X of N”
- Prefer return-email / browser-saved product photos over HTML scrape
- One page per item unless settings say otherwise
- Never invent barcodes, order ids, ASINs, deadlines

## Amazon WF navy layout
Navy `#15253D`, pale `#EEF5FB`, border `#C9D6E2`. Summary page + one item page each with PRODUCT IMAGE | SCAN AT DROP-OFF.

## Email per send mode
just me | just someone else | me + someone else | ask every time — collect recipients at delivery when ask-every-time. Draft/send-on-behalf; never silent send. Discover From at runtime.

## Anti-patterns
Upscaling blurry QR; chrome as product photo; fail-open without QR; email before attaching PDF; baking personal emails.

# Retailer return assist

Assisted non-Amazon retailer returns (Target / Walmart / similar) and retailer CS for returns. Confirm before every submit. Amazon → Amazon return questionnaire.

## Done checklist
- [ ] Input from inventory stable_ids or order link/screenshot — never invent catalog
- [ ] computerUse / box-desktop on retailer return pages — no auto-submit
- [ ] Confirm-before-submit before every commit
- [ ] CS From = purchase mailbox (infer from confirmation mail); ASK if unclear; never random inbox
- [ ] Label issued → send mode / Returns Desk PDF pack; QR dropoff → PDF pack
- [ ] Stuck (auth/captcha/policy): hand user the screen with next step
- [ ] No chargebacks/disputes as core job; no silent retailer sends

## Anti-patterns
Auto-submit; random From; Amazon in this skill; inventing labels/QR; silent sends.
